category_dispositions.schemas_contracts: HISTORICAL_ONLY; adopted semantics require their separate Harness Rig specifications and dispositions.

category_dispositions.openspec: HISTORICAL_ONLY; imported change archives do not become active Harness Rig authority.
category_dispositions.agent_roles: HISTORICAL_ONLY; source skills and agent instructions are not installed by importing history.
